name: Darius
title: the Hand of Noxus

Q.name: Decimate
Q.description: Darius hefts his axe then swings it around, dealing 50/80/110/140/170 + (100/110/120/130/140 × 0.01)×AD physical damage with the edge and (50/80/110/140/170 + (100/110/120/130/140 × 0.01)×AD) × 0.35 damage with the handle. Enemies hit with the handle do not take a Hemorrhage stack. Darius restores 17% missing Health per enemy champion and large jungle monster hit with the edge, up to a max of 51%.
Q.summary: Darius winds up and swings his axe in a wide circle. Enemies struck by the blade take more damage than those struck by the handle. Darius heals based on enemy champions and large monsters hit by the blade.

W.name: Crippling Strike
W.description: Darius' next Attack deals 1.4/1.45/1.5/1.55/1.6×AD physical damage and Slows by 90% for 1 second. This Ability refunds its Mana cost and reduces its Cooldown by 50% if it kills the target. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.
W.summary: Darius's next attack strikes an enemy's crucial artery. As they bleed out, their Move Speed is slowed.

E.name: Apprehend
E.description: Passive: Darius gains 20/25/30/35/40% Armor Penetration. Active: Darius hooks with his axe, Pulling, and Knocking Up and Slowing by 40% for 1 second.
E.summary: Darius hones his axe, passively causing his physical damage to ignore a percentage of his target's Armor. When activated, Darius sweeps up his enemies with his axe's hook and pulls them to him.

R.name: Noxian Guillotine
R.description: Darius leaps to an enemy and strikes a lethal blow, dealing 125/250/375 + 0.75×bonus AD true damage. For each Hemorrhage on the target, this Ability deals an additional 20% damage, up to a max of (125/250/375 + 0.75×bonus AD) × 2 damage. If this kills the target, Darius may Recast this Ability once within 20 seconds. At rank 3, this Ability has no Mana cost and kills refresh the Cooldown completely.
R.summary: Darius leaps to an enemy champion and strikes a lethal blow, dealing true damage. This damage is increased for each stack of Hemorrhage on the target. If Noxian Guillotine is a killing blow, its cooldown is refreshed for a brief duration.

Passive.name: Hemorrhage
Passive.description: Darius' attacks and damaging abilities cause enemies to bleed for physical damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Darius enrages and gains massive Attack Damage when his target reaches max stacks.
Passive.summary: Darius' attacks and damaging abilities cause enemies to bleed for physical damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Darius enrages and gains massive Attack Damage when his target reaches max stacks.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Lane bully who stacks bleeds to 5 for Noxian Might, pulls you back in with E, and resets R on kills.
strengths: Wins extended trades and all-ins once stacks build
Q blade heals and punishes melee in range
R resets make him a teamfight snowballer
weaknesses: No dash; kited by ranged and by champions who space the Q blade
Hard to engage when E is down

curve.lvl1: strong – W + passive stacking (Q or E start)

profile.curveNote: Strong from level 1; level 2-3 E pull is his main kill window.

keyAbilities.trading: Q blade, W into passive stacks

Q.notes: area: blade vs handle; dodge the blade ring

W.notes: empowered attack: dodged by Jax E

E.notes: pull + knock-up (tenacity doesn't shorten it; parried by Fiora W → Darius stunned)

R.notes: point-and-click true damage execute; resets on kill

profile.windowAgainst: E on cooldown (16–26 s): he can't pull you back.
